fit_authority: Each BNCI participant's previously authorized C800 only; stop before flash 801 onset; no samples or labels from T in numerical research inputs
split_unit: leave-one-participant-out; multiple pseudo-cuts within one record are dependent repeated measurements
source_prior_interpretation: Seven source participants form each training prior; target participant excluded. This is not a K200 personal fit or a transfer performance estimate
event_indices: zero-based 128 through 672 inclusive, step 24; no score-based exclusions
reference: production filter on C800 only; finite conditional reference, not ideal infinite-context ground truth
transform: existing production 0.1-30 Hz / 50 Hz Q30 SOS; epoch FFT/crop/baseline; native eight physical channels; fixed first eight DCT coordinates per channel
conditional_context: finite output's 64 coordinates plus per-channel left/right means and endpoint slopes; all obtained inside the pseudo-cut
conditional_fit: standardized ridge, alpha = number of source cuts; no model selection
covariance_fit: class means on seven source participants, unshrunk paired empirical covariance plus shared 0.001 relative ridge for scores; exact algebra also checked without ridge
controls: full paired covariance including cross term
long covariance plus delta covariance omitting cross term
finite covariance plus delta covariance (double count)
conditional delta prediction with residual covariance
forbidden_claims: identified physiological noise from total signal covariance
Γ=estimated just because its basis represents oracle differences
